title: MCITEBENCH: A Multimodal Benchmark for Generating Text with Citations

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model citation performance (Source Exact Match and Source F1 scores) across different input modalities (text, figures, tables) in mixed-modality settings, and analyzing the models' attention score distributions across these multimodal inputs during citation generation.

Conducting an ablation study comparing the evaluation scores assigned by GPT-4o against those of another LLM judge (DeepSeek V3-0324) on a randomly sampled subset to verify if the GPT-4o judge systematically favors its own generated outputs.
